title: capture.status
description: Body of the capture helper's GET /status (and of a 503 from GET /frame). HTTP, not a host-connection message, so no envelope.

window.description: Title of the selected window, or null if none is selected.

frame.description: Number of the newest frame kept (its ETag), or null before the first frame.

fps.description: Measured capture rate; 0 when not capturing.

message.description: Why the state isn't capturing; empty while capturing.
